_comment: LV-6 G1 PROBE — 40 epochs over the §29.5-biased wsh fixture runs/simnet50_wsh_f29p5.
Three jobs, all cheap, ALL of them owed BEFORE the 4 h arm is worth spending:
1. network_estimability.csv -> place network.rank_gate_tol from THIS arm's own dump
(BeiDou card rule; SPEC_synthetic_minimum_network §12.2 rung 4 used 1e-12 on the
300-station lineage -- NEVER copy it globally, assertNullSpaceRank throws in both
directions).  Expect 0 epochs emitted here: the PB|*|L2W near-null withholds until
the tol is placed, and that does not matter for jobs 2 and 3.
2. network_level_authority.csv -> the SIGN and magnitude of L_cs.  The census sits in
the serial pre-PASS-B slot, UPSTREAM of every withhold decision, so it writes FLEET
rows even on a run that emits nothing.  This is what settles the §29.5 sign
convention BY MEASUREMENT instead of by argument (see the fixture header).
3. G4 counter wiring: the run-end 'LV-6 level-authority census' line must report
~30 FLEET epochs (40 minus the min_n = 10 warmup).  ZERO past warmup is a MISWIRE.
cycle_slip.gap_instrument is pinned per SPEC_level_authority_internal §5 item 3 so that
cardsArmed() is equal against any control twin.
